create_service_with_action_registry: create a Service instance with an ActionRegistry to handle incoming connections
create_service_with_async_handler: create a Service with an async connection handler for coroutine-based request processing
wrap_async_handler: wrap an async connection handler to run safely inside the asyncio event loop
wrap_sync_handler: wrap a sync connection handler to automatically convert pybind objects to Python Session
wrap_handler: inspect and wrap a connection handler as either async or sync before passing to Service
